selected_evidence.requirement: Create appworker and configure login limits
selected_evidence.summary: Account, limits file, ownership, and live login shell verified; nofile=8192/8192 and nproc=256/256.
Healthy baseline boot ID b35fad86-4e61-46bf-bbd2-0dadcedb685d; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID b0a9ac32-983c-4d02-9f63-2a83a3bd9002; sshd, account, configuration, and live limits recovered.

commands.command: id; cat /etc/redhat-release; getent passwd appworker || true; grep -R '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true; grep -n 'pam_limits.so' /etc/pam.d/sshd /etc/pam.d/login /etc/pam.d/system-auth 2>/dev/null || true
commands.stdout:
uid=1000(antrieb) gid=1000(antrieb) groups=1000(antrieb) context=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023
Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server release 7.9 (Maipo)
/etc/pam.d/system-auth:20:session     required      pam_limits.so

commands.command: sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appworker && printf '%s\n' 'appworker soft nofile 8192' 'appworker hard nofile 8192' 'appworker soft nproc 256' 'appworker hard nproc 256' | sudo -n tee /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf >/dev/null && sudo -n chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf

getent passwd appworker; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/appworker /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf; sudo -n cat /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf; sudo -n -iu appworker bash -lc 'printf "identity=%s
" "$(id)"; printf "nofile_soft=%s nofile_hard=%s
" "$(ulimit -Sn)" "$(ulimit -Hn)"; printf "nproc_soft=%s nproc_hard=%s
" "$(ulimit -Su)" "$(ulimit -Hu)"'
commands.stdout:
appworker:x:1001:1001::/home/appworker:/bin/bash
appworker:appworker 700 /home/appworker
root:root 644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
identity=uid=1001(appworker) gid=1001(appworker) groups=1001(appworker) context=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023
nofile_soft=8192 nofile_hard=8192
nproc_soft=256 nproc_hard=256

commands.command: printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'sshd='; systemctl is-active sshd; getent passwd appworker; sudo -n test -f /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf && printf 'limits_file=present\n'; sudo -n -iu appworker bash -lc 'printf "login_limits nofile=%s/%s nproc=%s/%s\n" "$(ulimit -Sn)" "$(ulimit -Hn)" "$(ulimit -Su)" "$(ulimit -Hu)"'
sudo -n sh -c '(sleep 2; /sbin/shutdown -r now) >/var/tmp/benchmark-reboot.log 2>&1 &' && printf 'restart_ack node=%s method=shutdown-r-now\n' "$NODE_NAME"
